note: Danske Bank's price book (updated 7 October 2026): at the standard price a Danske Konto (any number, with internet and mobile banking) costs 35 kroner a month, charged quarterly (105 a quarter). Customers aged 18 to 35 get the Danske Hverdag+ package, which includes the account, at 0 kroner, so the game waives the fee under 36.
